definitions.gloss: downtown, old town, low-lying area of a city
definitions.explanation: The older, traditional commercial and residential areas of a city, typically in lower-lying areas, associated with working-class culture and traditional atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{下町|したまち}には{古|ふる}い{街並|まちな}みが{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Old townscapes remain in Tokyo's downtown area.

examples.japanese: {下町|したまち}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the atmosphere of the old downtown.

examples.japanese: {下町|したまち}{育|そだ}ちの{人|ひと}は{人情|にんじょう}に{厚|あつ}いと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: People raised in the old downtown are said to be warm-hearted.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{下町|したまち} refers to the traditional working-class areas of Japanese cities, particularly Tokyo. Areas like 浅草 (Asakusa), 上野 (Ueno), and 両国 (Ryogoku) are considered classic 下町. It's associated with:
・{人情|にんじょう} (warmth, humanity)
・{職人|しょくにん} (craftspeople)
・{伝統|でんとう}{的|てき}な{店|みせ} (traditional shops)
・{祭|まつ}り (festivals)

OPPOSITE:
・{山|やま}の{手|て} (uptown, residential hillside areas)

[Register: Neutral]
